module.name: Directory Core
common.loadFailedHint: The request failed, so nothing was read. Refresh to try again.
navigation.tokensDescription: Credentials an identity provider uses to provision this workspace.
navigation.groupsDescription: Which provider group grants which workspace role.
navigation.logDescription: Every SCIM operation this workspace received and its outcome.
tokens.title: SCIM tokens
tokens.description: An identity provider authenticates with one of these tokens to provision members of this workspace. A token carries no member permission.
tokens.denied: You need the SCIM token read permission to open this screen.
tokens.note: A token value is shown once, at creation and at rotation. Only its fingerprint is readable afterwards.
tokens.column.label: Label
tokens.action.rotateRefused: An expired token cannot be rotated. Revoke it and issue a new one.
tokens.table.title: Tokens
tokens.table.caption: SCIM tokens of this workspace
tokens.search.label: Search tokens
tokens.empty.title: No SCIM tokens yet
tokens.empty.hint: Create a token and paste it into your identity provider to start provisioning.
tokens.emptyFiltered.title: No token matches
tokens.emptyFiltered.hint: Change the search or the status filter.
tokens.drawer.newSubtitle: The value is shown once and cannot be read again.
tokens.drawer.issuedSubtitle: Copy it now: closing this panel drops it for good.
tokens.reveal.warning: This is the only time the token is shown. Store it in your identity provider before closing.
tokens.reveal.label: Token value
tokens.reveal.help: Send it as Authorization: Bearer on every SCIM request.
tokens.form.label: Label
tokens.form.labelHelp: Names the provider this token belongs to, such as Okta production.
tokens.form.expiryHelp: Optional, at most one year ahead. Leave it empty for a token that does not expire.
tokens.form.note: The token is generated by the server and stored only as a hash.
tokens.rotate.title: Rotate this token?
tokens.rotate.description: A new value replaces "{label}" immediately and the old value stops working. Provisioning fails until the provider holds the new value.
tokens.revoke.title: Revoke this token?
tokens.revoke.description: "{label}" stops working immediately and every SCIM request through it is refused.
tokens.error.load: Could not load the SCIM tokens.
groups.title: Group mappings
groups.description: A provider group grants one workspace role. When a member belongs to several mapped groups, the lowest precedence number wins.
groups.denied: You need the provisioning read permission to open this screen.
groups.note: A member in no mapped group receives the workspace default role, {role}.
groups.column.name: Group
groups.table.title: Groups
groups.table.caption: SCIM groups of this workspace
groups.search.label: Search groups
groups.empty.title: No groups yet
groups.empty.hint: Groups appear here once the identity provider pushes them through SCIM.
groups.emptyFiltered.title: No group matches
groups.drawer.subtitle: Set the role this group grants and how it ranks against other groups.
groups.form.roleHelp: Members of this group receive this role. Saving re-derives the role of every member.
groups.form.precedenceHelp: 0 to 10000. A lower number wins when a member belongs to several mapped groups.
groups.form.note: The last active owner cannot be demoted here or through SCIM.
groups.error.load: Could not load the group mappings.
groups.error.precedence: Precedence must be a whole number between 0 and 10000.
log.title: Provisioning log
log.description: One entry per SCIM operation, with the token that made it and the stable reason for every refusal.
log.denied: You need the provisioning read permission to open this screen.
log.note: Entries record the token id and the operation, never the token value.
log.column.subject: Subject
log.table.title: Operations
log.table.caption: Provisioning operations of this workspace
log.empty.title: Nothing provisioned yet
log.empty.hint: Operations appear here as soon as the identity provider starts sending them.
log.emptyFiltered.title: No entry matches
log.emptyFiltered.hint: Change the operation or outcome filter.
log.error.load: Could not load the provisioning log.

settings.defaultRole.label: Default provisioned role
settings.defaultRole.description: The workspace role a provisioned user receives when no mapped group applies.
settings.pageSizeMax.label: Maximum SCIM page size
settings.pageSizeMax.description: Upper bound of the SCIM count parameter. A larger request is clamped to this value.
